design_choices.canonical_query_only: Core evaluation uses a single occupation_query: "What is {entity}'s occupation?\nReply with only the occupation title." The previous paraphrase Q2 is not part of dataset_v3. The query already contains the reply instruction, so the recall renderer does not append 'Reply with only the answer.'
design_choices.carpenter_replaced_by_cashier: S4 carpenter failed one source-present cell under the occupation query. It was replaced by cashier rather than tuning the carpenter description after observing that failure. Carpenter is not in the active v3 core.
design_choices.chat_rendered_write_metadata: Raw sentences are the dataset source of truth. Chat-rendered token spans are also stored using the Exp 02A convention (official chat template, user turn = 'Fact:\n' + sentence, no assistant turn) so future NTP masking does not have to re-derive offsets. This wrapper is metadata only in this stage; no optimization is run.
design_choices.independent_sequences: Each mapping is two independent write sequences, never concatenated. Future LoRA will batch the two sequences and average their CE. Concatenation would introduce sentence-order / cross-sentence causal conditioning.
design_choices.prefix_target_split: Prefix/context = '{entity} spends most workdays' (no trailing space). Target = '{description}.' including the final period. The space between workdays and the description is a boundary token and is not part of the description substring; future CE labels use character-offset overlap with the description span plus the sentence-final period.
design_choices.source_present_prompt: Calibration puts BOTH mapping sentences in one user message (Fact:\n + sentence1 + newline + sentence2), then the query. This is in-context semantic inference, not the write format, and not KV reuse.
design_choices.static_source_free_diagnostic: Same occupation-label scoring with descriptions absent and no LoRA. Diagnostic only; it does not select or rewrite the dataset.

note: Frozen only after lexical audit and source-present calibration. Do not alter in place. Future changes require dataset_v4.

revised_source_present_calibration.rule: lexical pass AND all 16 uplift_margin>0 AND all 4 B_swap>0
